_comment: Atmosphere & recovery chunk 2, §6.2 (decided): the campfire's heal. Uncapped (maxTargets 0) — a campfire heals EVERY wounded aligned entity in range (players + summons/companions), no lowest-health pick. Heals in combat: yes (v1) — attrition rides the chunk-1 regen gate. Cadence sized so zero-to-full ≈ 15–20 s (GDD §3 rhythm): 6 HP per 30-tick (~1 s) tick on a 100-HP pool ≈ 17 s. No selfDamageHP — the self-cost is a player build-cost lever; a mob caster pays none. Chunk 3 adds the big light_aura (rendering-only, streams as light_radius) — the first unequal-radii skill: heal stays r1.5 via the per-effect range check, light never touches sensor/aura_radius. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
